svg.title: System landscape
svg.desc: The people (sangat and students, Granthis and scholars, engineers), the three surfaces they use (website, iOS app, wiki), the stdlib API and the pinned database behind them, the source Bir PDF and the labelled English layer that feed the data, and the CI pipeline that is the only way anything reaches production.
